name: highlighter
title: Text Highlighter
description: A hand-drawn mark draws itself on a word: highlighter, underline, box, circle, strike-through, crossed-off or bracket (0.6 s, two rough passes).

moworks.author: magicui

options.action: highlight | underline | box | circle | strike-through | crossed-off | bracket (highlight)

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked
credit.upstream: rough-notation (MIT) by Preet Shihn draws the original marks

moworks.notes: Upstream draws with rough-notation (MIT, Preet Shihn); its code is not used: the strokes here are drawn with the app's seeded generator, same mark types, timing and defaults. Multiline: one mark per line box.
